title: Present Simple
explanation: Use the present simple for habits, routines, and facts that are generally true. With he, she, and it, add -s (or -es) to the verb: I work → she works, I go → he goes. For negatives and questions, use do/does: She doesn't work. Does he go?
explanationPersian: از حال ساده برای عادت‌ها، کارهای روزمره و حقایق کلی استفاده می‌شود. با he/she/it به فعل s- یا es- اضافه کنید. برای منفی و سوالی از do/does استفاده کنید.

examples.english: Does he play football? — No, he doesn't.
examples.persian: آیا او فوتبال بازی می‌کند؟ — نه.

exercises.explanation: With she, add -es to go: she goes.
exercises.explanationPersian: با she فعل go به goes تبدیل می‌شود.

exercises.explanation: With he/she/it use doesn't, not don't.
exercises.explanationPersian: با he/she/it از doesn't استفاده می‌شود نه don't.

exercises.explanation: Questions with he/she/it start with Does + subject + base verb.
exercises.explanationPersian: سؤال با he/she/it با Does + فاعل + فعل ساده شروع می‌شود.

options: I am go to the gym on Mondays.
I goes to the gym on Mondays.
I go to the gym on Mondays.
I going to the gym on Mondays.
exercises.explanation: With I, use the base verb: I go.
exercises.explanationPersian: با I از فعل ساده استفاده می‌کنیم: I go.

exercises.source: او هر روز انگلیسی مطالعه می‌کند.
او هر روز صبح ساعت هفت از خواب بیدار می‌شود.
acceptedAnswers: She gets up at seven every morning.
He gets up at seven every morning.
She wakes up at seven every morning.
He wakes up at seven every morning.
She gets up at 7 every morning.
He gets up at 7 every morning.
Every morning she gets up at seven.
Every morning he gets up at seven.

commonErrors.feedback: With he / she / it the verb needs -s: gets, wakes.
commonErrors.feedbackPersian: با he / she / it فعل s می‌گیرد: gets، wakes.

exercises.explanationPersian: با he / she / it به فعل s اضافه می‌شود.

commonErrors.feedback: With 'my sister' (she) use doesn't, not don't.
commonErrors.feedbackPersian: با my sister (she) باید doesn't بیاید، نه don't.

commonErrors.feedback: After doesn't use the base verb: like.
commonErrors.feedbackPersian: بعد از doesn't فعل ساده می‌آید: like.

exercises.explanation: does not + base verb: the -s moves to 'does'.
exercises.explanationPersian: در منفی s به does می‌رود و فعل ساده می‌ماند.

exercises.prompt: Make this a question: "She speaks English at work."
acceptedAnswers: Does she speak English at work?

commonErrors.feedback: After 'Does' use the base verb: speak.
commonErrors.feedbackPersian: بعد از Does فعل ساده می‌آید: speak.
